statement: At pinned consumers, LE u32 button bits of 0x42/0x45/0x47 occupy bytes 2-5: byte2 bits0-7 A,B,X,Y,QAM,R-stick click,Menu,R4; byte3 bits0-7 R5,R shoulder,DPAD down/right/left/up,View,L-stick click; byte4 bits0-7 Steam,L4,L5,L shoulder,R stick touch,R pad touch,R pad click,R trigger click; byte5 bits0-5 L stick touch,L pad touch,L pad click,L trigger click,R grip touch,L grip touch; bits6-7 not mapped. The kernel enumerates mapped buttons at hid-steam.c:2360-2418 and SDL identifies corresponding capsense and native controls in steam_triton.c:60-98. These are raw bits, not physical validation.

applicability.revision: host consumers at Linux v7.3-rc1 and SDL 6defbc0; physical revision not measured
applicability.scope: Wired USB 28de:1302; host-side source parsing / host commands only, no live or physical validation. Refer to docs/steam-controller-2026-research-gaps.md C6 section.
